note: Part of the core family: the keys whose installed wording only trips the review-class rules (organisation, equipment, government, ideology, trains, operations, Ironman, American spellings). The glossary decides each term (organisation = Cohesion, equipment = Gear, government = Rule, ideology = Alignment, train = Wagon Train, operation = Scheme, ironman = Iron Oath).

lit.AIR_SUPERIORITY_BAR_EXPLANATION: Each kind of wing has a set power of mastery, which tells how well it commands the sky. The power in a region is the sum of all your active wings there and those of your {faction:lc}. The more wings, the higher the power, but it also falls when the region is thinly covered. So move your wings to the bases that give the best cover.

lit.AIR_WING_XP_LOSS_INFO: When the §Y{air_wing}§! takes damage it loses experience. The loss is lessened by $FRIENDLY|+%0$ over friendly land.
